edits.new: No child workflow and no second queue. The activity name is a design choice of this story; the two boundary activities run on the owner's queue. The consumed operation names of rwb-case, rwb-payment and rwb-partner are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2907; ASM-4805); the build runs against the documents and their fakes, and P3, P8 and S9 publish the names at the tag of RWB-S5-E4024-CON. API-S5-005 (POST /listings/{listingId}/rounds) carries the round write and the accept of a bid, declared once for this story; the baselines agree the posted fields at the tag. R-DIS-49 and R-DIS-50 are evaluated once, in this story; R-DIS-47 and R-DIS-48 belong to the payment-term story (FEAT-AST-18) and are not evaluated here. R-DIS-11 and R-DIS-37 are declared once for rwb-asset as the state gates they name; R-DIS-37 is also built by FEAT-AST-15, and that duplication is recorded for the story-split review.
